analysis_result.analysis: The model’s reasoning failed on multiple levels. First, it misperceived the cube configurations, incorrectly assuming only three cubes have red faces and that each has only one. In reality, Cube 3 (left and right faces), Cube 4 (top and bottom), and Cube 5 (top) also have red faces — totaling more than 3 red faces overall. Second, it ignored the camera’s perspective (phi=70°, theta=-45°), which hides the IN, LEFT, and UP faces — including several red ones. The model wrongly assumed that if a red face is visible in the final frame, no red faces are hidden, which is a fundamental spatial reasoning error.
